source:
@@U04485@@
What horror threatens me from the world grown dark! I see flashes of sparks exploding among the dark lindens; fire raging, fanned by the whipping breeze; the moss-covered cottage burning inside! I see no help in sight, no rescue! Ah, that dear old couple, always so careful with fire, victims now of the smoky blaze. What a disaster! The house’s mossy frame stands black against the crimson flames. Oh, if only they've escaped, those dear, good people, from that raging inferno. Tongues of flame lick upward through leaves and boughs, dry branches catch fire and as they burn break off and crash to earth. Why, why must I have eyes to see this? Why so farsighted? There, the chapel, collapsing under falling branches! Great swirls of pointed flames rage in the treetops, and down to their roots the hollow trunks glow crimson.

@@U04486@@
(Long pause. Sings.)

@@U04487@@
What was once so dear a sight Now is swallowed up in night.

@@U04489@@
(On the balcony, facing the dunes.)

@@U04490@@
What is that wailing dirge I hear? Too late, too late.
translation:
@@U04485@@
黑暗的世界正向我发出怎样的恐怖威胁！我看到黑暗的椴树丛中迸发出火花；火势猛烈，微风煽动；长满青苔的小屋在里面燃烧！我看不到任何帮助，没有救援！啊，那对亲爱的老夫妇，总是对火如此小心，现在成了烟雾缭绕的大火的受害者。真是一场灾难！房子的长满青苔的框架在深红色的火焰的衬托下显得很黑。哦，要是他们能逃离那熊熊的地狱就好了，那些亲爱的好人。火舌向上舔过树叶和树枝，干燥的树枝着火，燃烧时折断并坠落到地上。为什么，为什么我必须有眼睛才能看到这个？为什么这么有远见？在那里，教堂在倒下的树枝下倒塌了！巨大的火焰漩涡在树顶上肆虐，空心的树干一直延伸到树根，发出猩红的光芒。

@@U04486@@
（长时间停顿。唱歌。）

@@U04487@@
曾经如此珍贵的景象如今已被夜色吞噬。

@@U04489@@
（在阳台上，面向沙丘。）

@@U04490@@
我听到的哀嚎是什么？太晚了，太晚了。
